text: ポケモンには　ボールの　ほかにも　エサや　いしを　なげられるよ　エサを　なげられた　ポケモンは　にげにくく　つかまりにくいし　いしを　なげられた　ポケモンは　にげやすく　つかまりやすい　みたい　じかんが　なくなるか　サファリボールを　ぜんぶ　なげたら　ゲームは　おわり　だよ！

structure.jp: ボールの　ほかにも
エサや　いしを　なげられるよ
structure.en: you can throw bait and rocks

structure.jp: エサを　なげられた　ポケモンは
structure.en: a Pokémon that had bait thrown at it

structure.jp: にげにくく　つかまりにくいし
structure.en: is less likely to flee and harder to catch, and

structure.jp: いしを　なげられた　ポケモンは
structure.en: a Pokémon that had a rock thrown at it

structure.jp: にげやすく　つかまりやすい　みたい
structure.en: seems more likely to flee and easier to catch

structure.jp: じかんが　なくなるか
structure.en: either the time runs out, or

structure.jp: サファリボールを　ぜんぶ　なげたら
structure.en: when you've thrown all the Safari Balls

structure.jp: ゲームは　おわり　だよ！

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: エサを　なげられた　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: The same なげられる that meant 'can throw' earlier here means it was done to someone, and the whole phrase describes the Pokémon after it. エサを　なげられた　ポケモン = 'a Pokémon that had bait thrown at it'.

patterns.name: 〜にくい
patterns.span: にげにくく　つかまりにくい
patterns.explanation: にくい after a verb stem means 'hard to do' (やすい is the opposite, 'easy to do'); the く ending joins it to the next one like 'and'. にげにくく　つかまりにくい = 'hard to run away and hard to get caught'.

patterns.name: 〜みたい
patterns.span: つかまりやすい　みたい
patterns.explanation: みたい at the end says 'it seems so', showing the speaker is not fully sure. つかまりやすい　みたい = 'seems to be easy to catch'.
